summary: Acknowledge only presented conversation prose, keep read positions reactive with all inventories, and bound prose lookups

replay.detail: No additional graph or projection replay beyond synced-read-positions.json. Prose indexes are built directly from retained local observations and claims during normal store opening.

schema.detail: Adds assistant message/content-only partial indexes claims_timeline_prose_time_index and local_observations_timeline_prose_index on existing stores using CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS. No numeric schema version transition or authoritative-state conversion; existing activity indexes remain in use.

rules.detail: No additional checkpoint-rules or claim-registry change beyond synced-read-positions.json and its registry-impact correction.

compatibility.detail: The TUI uses one additional authenticated stream connection only when the daemon supports read positions, dedicated to their invalidations. The shared 16-subscription admission limit and all six inventories remain unchanged. Refused read-position subscriptions are surfaced instead of replaced with periodic HTTP listing. The phone exposes list failures in read-position state and retries only unreachable peer or transport failures with connection-scoped capped backoff; success stops retries, and disconnect cancels them. Refusals and local defects remain visible without retry loops. Older binaries can ignore the additive indexes; mixed-version behavior remains unverified.

downtime.detail: First-open construction of the two indexes completes before serving and has not been timed on retained histories. Normal restart-to-API and restart-to-health durations remain unmeasured; allow opening and recovery to complete.

manual.detail: No additional manual migration, re-pairing or identity reset. Normal store opening installs the additive indexes. Client updates restrict synced acknowledgement to transcript prose actually presented.

recovery.detail: Additive indexes need no state conversion for older readers and remain after binary replacement. Broader accepted read-position claim downgrade constraints from the earlier fragments still apply. Mixed-version swap-back and recovery have not been exercised; preserve claims and identity and roll forward if needed.
